description: Newhaven Arena (1:2150): one player stands in the arena for five minutes and watches the monsters arrive (generate_monsters_near_users): at most one monster with one player, the first within a few 5-second passes (89 rolls of 99 each). Not yet captured on the original: the differential run records both sides live.
behaviours: spawns scale with the players in the room (each player rolls with the first one's counts)

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
HP/mana in the prompt depend on earlier fights and regen

mask.regex: for \d+ damage|You gain \d+ experience|\d+ (?:copper farthings?|silver nobles?|gold crowns?|platinum pieces?|runic coins?)
mask.why: RNG: damage, experience share, coin drops

notes: Written by T-035 for T-040; no capture yet (raw.bin/plain.txt come from the first differential run).
With one player the arena holds at most one monster, so the count is the time to the first arrival plus any arrivals after the monster leaves; a second player doubles the cap.

steps.note: five minutes in the arena: every monster_arrives event counts (T-040 compares the counts per minute)
